label: First Way mover is necessary, from firstness, unreceivedness and C2
meaning: Take the prima via's first mover f. It moves something, so it exists at w (B0). Suppose it is absent at some accessible world: then it is contingent at w and C2 makes it existentially receptive or gives it a distinct, simply prior CAUSE_2 of its esse. Received esse and matter-form composition are excluded by unreceivedness; a distinct simply prior cause is excluded by firstness (it would be f itself). So f is present at every accessible world (excluded middle). Pure act (POTENCY_1 in no respect) is carried for the endpoint and does no work: necessity comes from unreceived esse and underivedness.

strong_version_needed.6508c239-b36d-4010-b9e4-ff0cdd5757e5: Firstness excludes only a SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 cause of the first mover; the weak form without the priority clause would need the existing B3 as a further premise to reach firstness. The same bundle with C2-minus and B3 is available through the registered C2-from-weak-form-and-B3 argument.
strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The proof applies excluded middle to propositions outside LocalLogic's scope, e.g. `F.history.ontic.ExistsAt v f`. LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
